main_text.p: & vexavit Epiphanius. Et quanquam in firma sit illius ratio, & vitiosus calculus, à nato Semo ad occursum Melchisedeci, modò annos MCXXX, modò MCXXVII. praeter Codicum Hebraeorum fidem, ingenti μεταχρονισμῷ, supputantis, aliis illi difficultatibus implicantur. Tum quia hæc sententia ex Hebraeorum lacunis hausta, qui & alia incerta de Melchisedeco; tum quia ut alium à Semo sistunt eum nobis sagacissimi Judæorum Josephus ac Philo, tum quia nec reticuisset Moses, nec Apostolus fusior aliâs in describendo Melchisedeco; imò verò quia hic negat Melchisedecum idem cum Levitis duxisse à majoribus genus, Hebr.vii.6. quia cum nominibus plane aliis anteponit Abrahamo, quàm ratione juris illius paterni, & avitæ potestatis; quia facit ἀπάτωρ, ἀμήτωρ, ἀγενεαλόγητος, cùm Semus nulla ratione fuerit talis, nec κατὰ τὸ ἄναρχ[?], nec κατὰ τὴν Φαιν[?], ipse γενεαλογούμενος; quia etiam Cananæa cujus Melchisedek regulus, non Semo, sed Chamo ejusque posteris cessit, ex Historicorum omnium fide; nec in Semo

page.notes: Running head and page number read as printed. The Greek words are only partly legible in the scan: "μεταχρονισμῷ", "κατὰ τὸ ἄναρχ[?]" and "κατὰ τὴν Φαιν[?]" are uncertain, and the final letters of the last two are not clear. The Roman numerals "mcxxx" and "mcxxvii" are set in lowercase-like forms in the scan and have been written as capitals. The catchword "sed" is taken from the bottom right of the page. No marginal notes, no footnotes.
